scenarios.M: Classification and bounded template reply generation; every request executes a model call, no result reuse.
scenarios.W: validate integer fields and compute total deterministically; classify text; combine total,currency,category; same deterministic preprocessing allowed on native baseline
scenarios.W_reuse: repeat identical requests, then change quantity by +1 and replace text with next cyclic case; full result reuse must invalidate; selective reuse requires field-specific keys

quality_gate.M: Whole response JSON, exact versioned keys and expected fields; template reply correctness only, not open-ended writing quality.
quality_gate.W: exact combined total,currency,category; schema and all fields must pass
quality_gate.claim_boundary: fixture correctness only; no broad semantic quality claim
